items.title: 肖战宁艺卓 Gucci新地广 亚洲女星0-1突破
items.summary: Gucci unveiled its FW26 ready-to-wear global ad campaign led by Demna, with aespa's Ning Yizhuo becoming the first Asian woman to appear in a Gucci seasonal ready-to-wear ad, alongside ambassador Xiao Zhan, Tom Brady, Shawn Mendes and Alex Consani. Notes TikTok content tied to Ning Yizhuo topped 1 billion views and industry observers questioned whether the rapid ambassador-to-campaign timeline (under 4 months) is sustainable versus traditional 2-3 year evaluation cycles.

items.title: Gucci官旗给宁艺卓P了裤子
items.summary: A verified entertainment blogger accused Gucci's official China account of digitally editing (photoshopping) ambassador Ning Yizhuo's pants in a campaign image, calling unauthorized alteration of designer work taboo; Gucci reportedly reverted the image afterward. Community reaction was mixed between mockery treating the edit as comedic and genuine criticism of brand localization/censorship practices.

items.title: Gucci官旗给nyz P了裤子
items.summary: Douban community thread discussing Gucci China's edited (more conservative) version of a Ning Yizhuo campaign photo versus the original international version, with users debating whether the change reflects domestic-market censorship norms; some joked the edit looked more sophisticated, others questioned brand authenticity and localization double standards.

items.title: [차이나 워치] 中 부유층 지갑 닫았다…명품 판매 10% 넘게 급감
items.summary: Korean trade-press coverage citing Bloomberg-tracked research showing China's top 25 luxury brands' July sales fell over 10%, with Kering's Gucci, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga among Kering/LVMH labels posting double-digit declines as Beijing's offshore-wealth tax crackdown, a falling stock market and weak real estate curb big-ticket spending by China's rich. Independent negative demand signal specifically naming Gucci.

items.title: 开云Q2止跌回暖，古驰修复仍要看中国
items.summary: Chinese financial press analysis of Kering's Q2 2026 results (H1 revenue EUR7.22bn, +1% comparable) noting Gucci's decline narrowed to -2% from -8% in Q1, but flags this marks a twelfth consecutive quarterly sales decline for the brand. An analyst quoted is skeptical the improvement reflects genuine brand restoration rather than temporary US channel adjustments, describing Gucci's positioning between luxury tiers as awkward and lacking a second growth driver; management says China recovery needs 12-24 months.

items.title: 2026年各大品牌包包回收价一览：LV、香奈儿、Gucci几折回收？
items.summary: Secondhand-market roundup reports Gucci's resale/buyback pricing is split: hero styles like the 1955 Horsebit and Jackie 1961 fetch 50-70% of retail on resale, while ordinary seasonal styles fetch only 30-50%, trailing Chanel and Hermes retention rates. Independent resale-market chatter reflecting consumer perception of weakening value-retention outside core icon bags.

items.title: 网友热议：宁艺卓Gucci首支广告大片登上全球推广榜前三
items.summary: Weibo fan/user discussion celebrating that Ning Yizhuo's debut Gucci ready-to-wear ad ranked in the global top three of a brand promotion tracking chart, framed as validating her rapid rise as ambassador. Organic fandom-volume SNS chatter, positive valence, subject to fandom-spike magnitude damping per rubric.

items.title: 中国で苦戦する「グッチ」、落ち込みが他社より激しい理由
items.summary: Forbes Japan analysis on why Gucci's China downturn is steeper than rivals, attributing it to market bifurcation (ultra-wealthy shifting to Hermes-tier brands, middle class pulling back under economic pressure) compounded by new offshore-tax enforcement curbing big-ticket spending by Kering's Gucci, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga. Independent critical analysis, negative for Gucci's competitive position.

items.source: Aol/Forum roundup (via search, discussing Fashion Spot forum)
items.title: Forum Members Review Demna's Fall 2026 Runway Debut as Gucci Creative Director
items.summary: Fashion forum members' mixed-to-negative reviews of Demna's Gucci runway debut described the collection as looking cheap and dated, calling it derivative of fast fashion and a new low for the house, while a smaller number appreciated Tom Ford-era nostalgia cues. Retained only as background context on persistent critical community sentiment toward Demna's Gucci direction; outside the fresh window, not counted as a new signal.
